text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Yasuda Kinen, where the spring King of the Mile is crowned.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Vodka declares she'll take out her strong opponents with her newly refined dash.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Yasuda Kinen's track has long straight stretches, perfect for Vodka to run full-throttle.
